question: The area of the parallelogram whose adjacent sides are given by the vectors $\vec{a} = 3\hat{i} + \hat{j} + 4\hat{k}$ and $\vec{b} = \hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k}$ is:
explanation:
Area of parallelogram is $|\vec{a} \times \vec{b}|$.

$\vec{a} \times \vec{b}=\begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 3 & 1 & 4 \\ 1 & -1 & 1 \end{vmatrix}$.

$=5\hat{i}+\hat{j}-4\hat{k}$.

Magnitude $=\sqrt{5^2+1^2+(-4)^2}=\sqrt{25+1+16}=\sqrt{42}$.

Hence the area is $\sqrt{42}$.
